messages:
june_lee: Hey team — got a claim denied from AcmeHealth for a physical therapy session last month. EOB says 'member not found (ID invalid)'. I used the ID on my card. Anyone seen this?
ashok: Ugh, annoying. Do you have the claim number and provider name?
june_lee: Claim #CH-459102, provider 'Motion PT', billed date 2026-02-14. Attached EOB snapshot (sent via DM).
people-ops-bot: Reminder: please don't post PHI in public channels. Use DM or HR case.
maria_p: @june_lee I can help — did Motion PT submit using the group number or your SSN? Often they mistakenly use SSN as member ID.
june_lee: They used the ID on the card (I think the group was missing). I texted them, waiting reply.
maria_p: Two options: ask provider to resubmit with the correct member ID/group and include EOB claim number; or we can open an appeal with AcmeHealth if provider resubmits and still denied. We can also contact Acme to update their member registry if it's an insurer issue.
june_lee: How long do resubmits usually take? I'm already out $120.
sam_finance: Provider resubmits typically 14-45 days; appeals add more. If you need fast reimbursement, we can do an interim reimbursement from Redwood (advancement) if it's a covered benefit and you provide receipts/EOB. @ben_h do we still have the ad-hoc reimbursement policy?
ben_h: Yes — VMAP (voluntary medical advance pay). Need completed expense form + EOB + provider invoice. Usually reimbursed within 5-7 business days. We'll do up to $500 per claim.
june_lee: Great — I'll submit the docs. What's the form link?
maria_p: Here: https://intranet.redwood/hr/forms/medical-advance-pay.pdf
ashok: Also ask Motion PT to include your member DOB and subscriber name — some systems match on subscriber.
june_lee: Thanks! One last Q — can Redwood call AcmeHealth directly? I don't want to chase the provider.
maria_p: We can call on your behalf but need an authorization signed. I'll DM you the HIPAA authorization template.
people-ops-bot: Case opened: HR-3589 for June Lee re: claim CH-459102.
june_lee: Awesome, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
